docs.text: ​由于​这个​现象​不怎么​好看​，​请​跳转​到​综合​练习​的​ ​按键​+​数码管​+AT24C02 ​部分​来​学习​。​这个​部分​不好​作为​模块​来​书写​，​很多​东西​直接​线网​数据​相连​没​啥​意义​。

docs.title: 二​、ADC（ADC081C021）
docs.text: ADC ​是​基于​ ADC081C021 ​芯片​实现​的​，​也​是​一款​基于​ IIC ​协议​的​芯片​。

docs.title: 寄存器​含义
docs.text:
​右侧​框图​从​上​往​下​的​含义​是​：

​结果​相关​

​转换​结果​ (Conversion Result)

​最高​转换​值​寄存器​ (Highest Conversion Register)

​最低​转换​值​寄存器​ (Lowest Conversion Register)

​配置​相关​

​配置​与​解码​逻辑​ (Configuration and Decode Logic)

​报警​相关​

​迟滞​ (Hysteresis)

​高限​ (High Limit) -> ​报警​/​自​检点​比较​器​ (Alert/Self-Point Comparator) <- ​低限​ (Low Limit)

​通过​访问​地址​就​可以​获取​数值​了​，​器件​的​地址​是​ 1010100（​在​数据​手册​ 24 ​页​最​下面​）。

docs.title: 源码
docs.text:
module adc # (
    parameter                                P_SYS_CLK         = 28'd50_000_000 ,  //​系统​时钟​频率​
    parameter                                P_IIC_SCL         = 28'd125_000    ,  //IIC SCL​时钟​频率​ 
    parameter                                P_DEVICE_ADDR     = 7 'b1010_100     //IIC​从​设备​ ​器件​地址​(​电位器​器件​地址​:1010_100)
    )(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire adc_start,
    output reg [7:0] adc_data_reg,
    output wire iic_scl,
    inout wire iic_sda
    );

// ADC​转换​结果​是​16​位​宽​的​所以​要​这样​写​
wire [15:0] iic_rdata;
reg  [15:0] iic_rdata_reg;
wire iic_rdata_valid;

always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        iic_rdata_reg <= 16'd0;
    end else if (iic_rdata_valid) begin
        iic_rdata_reg <= iic_rdata;
    end else begin
      // ​由​手册​18​页​可知​ D11:D8 ​和​ D7:D4 ​为​数据​值​
        adc_data_reg <= {iic_rdata_reg[11:8],iic_rdata_reg[7:4]};
    end
end

iic_drive # (
    .P_SYS_CLK             (P_SYS_CLK),
    .P_IIC_SCL             (P_IIC_SCL),
    .P_DEVICE_ADDR         (P_DEVICE_ADDR),
    .P_ADDR_BYTE_NUM       (), // ​默认​就行​，​因为​地址​指针​寄存器​默认​就是​0，​不​需要​配置​
    .P_DATA_BYTE_NUM       (8 'd2)
)u_iic_drive (
    .iic_clk              (clk),
    .iic_rst              (rst),
//IIC​传输​启动​                                    
    .iic_start            (adc_start),
    .iic_ready            (),
    .iic_rw_flag          (1'd1),//​只读​模式​
//IIC​写​数据​              ​只读​不写​                                      
    .iic_word_addr        (),
    .iic_wdata            (),
//IIC​读数据​                                       
    .iic_rdata            (iic_rdata),
    .iic_rdata_valid      (iic_rdata_valid),
//IIC​操作​失败​                                              
    .iic_ack_error        (),
//IIC​物理​IO            
    .iic_scl              (iic_scl),   
    .iic_sda              (iic_sda)
);    

endmodule

docs.title: 代码​验证
docs.text:
​使用​数码管​显示​ ADC ​采集​到​的​电位器​数值​：

module top(
    input wire sys_clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    output wire [7:0] com,
    output wire [7:0] seg,
    output wire scl,
    inout wire sda
    );

wire [7:0] adc_data;
reg [31:0] disp_num;
reg [7:0] blank_en;

// ​转码​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n)begin
    if(rst_n) begin
        disp_num <= 32'd0;
    end else begin
        disp_num [11:8] <= (adc_data > 99)?(adc_data / 100) : 4'd0;
        disp_num [ 7:4] <= (adc_data > 9)?(adc_data % 100 / 10) : 4'd0;
        disp_num [ 3:0] <= adc_data % 10;
    end
end

// ​灭​零​逻辑​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n)begin
    if(rst_n) begin
        // ​只用​三位​数码管​
        blank_en <= 8'b1111_1000;
    end else begin
        if(! disp_num [ 7:4] && ! disp_num [11:8])
            blank_en <= 8'b1111_1110;
        else if (! disp_num [11:8])
            blank_en <= 8'b1111_1100;
        else
            blank_en <= 8'b1111_1000;
    end
end

seg u_seg (
    .clk            (sys_clk),
    .rst            (rst_n),
    .disp_num       (disp_num),
    .blank_en       (blank_en),
    .piont_en       (),
    .com_io         (com),
    .seg_io         (seg)
);

adc u_adc(
    .clk           (sys_clk         ),
    .rst           (rst_n         ),
    .adc_start     (1'd1   ), // ​一直​读​
    .adc_data_reg  (adc_data),
    .iic_scl       (scl     ),
    .iic_sda       (sda     )
    );

endmodule

docs.title: 三​、DAC（DAC5571IDBVR）
docs.text: DAC ​是​基于​ DAC5571IDBVR ​芯片​实现​的​，​也​是​一款​基于​ IIC ​协议​的​芯片​。

docs.title: 数据
docs.text: ​数据​也​是​两个​字节​，D11:D8 ​和​ D7:D4。

docs.title: 源码
docs.text:
module dac # (
    parameter                                P_SYS_CLK         = 28'd50_000_000 ,  //​系统​时钟​频率​
    parameter                                P_IIC_SCL         = 28'd125_000    ,  //IIC SCL​时钟​频率​ 
    parameter                                P_DEVICE_ADDR     = 7 'b1001_000     //IIC​从​设备​ ​器件​地址​1 0 0 1 1 0 A0 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire dac_start,
    input wire [7:0] dac_data_in,
    output wire iic_scl,
    inout wire iic_sda
    );

reg [7:0] dac_data;

always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        dac_data <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
        dac_data <= dac_data_in;
    end
end

iic_drive # (
    .P_SYS_CLK           (P_SYS_CLK),
    .P_IIC_SCL           (P_IIC_SCL),
    .P_DEVICE_ADDR       (P_DEVICE_ADDR),
    .P_ADDR_BYTE_NUM     (8'd0),
    .P_DATA_BYTE_NUM     (8'd2)
) u_iic_drive(  
    .iic_clk             (clk),
    .iic_rst             (rst),

    .iic_start           (dac_start),
    .iic_ready           (),
    .iic_rw_flag         ('d0),// ​始终​写入​

    .iic_word_addr       (),
    .iic_wdata           ({4'b0000,dac_data,4'b0000}),


    .iic_rdata           (),
    .iic_rdata_valid     (),

    .iic_ack_error       (),

    .iic_scl             (iic_scl),
    .iic_sda             (iic_sda)
);

endmodule

docs.title: 检测​方式
docs.text:
​观察​ LED（​测试点​旁边​）​亮度​。

module top(
    input wire sys_clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire [3:0] key,
    output wire scl,
    inout wire sda
    );

reg [7:0]  dac_data;
wire [3:0]  key_val;

// ​如果​没有​万用表​，​可以​观察​灯​的​亮度​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if(rst_n) begin
        dac_data <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
        case (key_val)
            4'b0001: dac_data <= 8'd78; // 1V
            4'b0010: dac_data <= 8'd155; // 2V
            4'b0100: dac_data <= 8'd233; // 3V
            4'b1000: dac_data <= dac_data + 8'd51; //​按​一​增加​0.66 ， ​复位​后​再​实验​
            4'b0000: dac_data <= dac_data;
        default : dac_data <= 8'd0;
        endcase
    end
end

key u_key (
    .clk             (sys_clk    ),
    .rst             (rst_n    ),
    .key_in          (key ),
    .key_neg         (key_val)
);

dac u_dac (
    .clk             (sys_clk), 
    .rst             (rst_n), 
    .dac_start       ('d1), 
    .dac_data_in     (dac_data),
    .iic_scl         (scl),
    .iic_sda         (sda)
);


endmodule

docs.title: 第六​部分​　SPI ​协议​与​ DS1302
docs.text: ​开发板​上​只有​一颗​ SPI ​协议​的​芯片​，​即​一块​ SPIFLASH（W25Q128JVS），​另外​还有​一颗​类似​ SPI ​协议​的​ DS1302。

docs.title: 官方​提供​的​主机​SPI​协议
docs.text:
module spi_master
#(
    parameter                           SYS_CLK                  = 28'd50_000_000   , //​系统​时钟​频率​
    parameter                           SPI_SCLK                 = 28'd100_000      , //SPI_SCLK​频率​
    parameter                           SPI_CPOL                 = 1'b0             , //​时钟​极性​
    parameter                           SPI_CPHA                 = 1'b0               //​时钟​相位​
)
(
    input                               spi_clk                                     ,
    input                               spi_rst                                     ,

    input  wire                         spi_cs_ctrl                                 ,//​片选​控制​端口​
    input  wire                         spi_wr_en                                   ,//​传输​使能​
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        spi_data_in                                 ,//​数据​输入​
    output wire        [   7: 0]        spi_data_out                                ,//​数据​输出​
    output wire                         spi_wr_ack                                  ,//​传输​结束​应答​

//SPI​物理​端口​
    output wire                         ds1302_ce                                    ,//​片选​端口​
    output reg                          ds1302_sclk                                  ,//SPI​时钟​
    output wire                         spi_mosi                                     ,//​用​三态​门​进行​构建​
    input  wire                         spi_miso                  
);

    localparam                          IDLE                     = 0                 ; //​空闲​状态​
    localparam                          H_SCLK_IDLE              = 1                 ; //SCLK​前​半​周期​
    localparam                          SCLK_EDGE                = 2                 ; //SCLK​边沿​时刻​
    localparam                          L_HALF_CYCLE             = 3                 ; //SCLK​后​半​周期​
    localparam                          ACK                      = 4                 ; //​应答​
    localparam                          ACK_WAIT                 = 5                 ;     

    reg                [   3: 0]        spi_state                                    ;
    reg                [  27: 0]        spi_sclk_cnt                                 ;
    reg                [  27: 0]        spi_edge_cnt                                 ;

    reg                [   7: 0]        mosi_shift                                   ;
    reg                [   7: 0]        miso_shift                                   ;

    assign                              spi_mosi                 = mosi_shift[7]     ;
    assign                              spi_data_out             = miso_shift        ;
    assign                              ds1302_ce                = spi_cs_ctrl       ;
    assign                              spi_wr_ack               = (spi_state == ACK); 

always@(posedge spi_clk or posedge spi_rst) begin
    if(spi_rst)
        spi_state <= IDLE;
    else begin
        case(spi_state)
            IDLE      :
                if(spi_wr_en)
                    spi_state <= H_SCLK_IDLE;
                else
                    spi_state <= IDLE;
            H_SCLK_IDLE :
                if(spi_sclk_cnt == 'd50)
                    spi_state <= SCLK_EDGE;
                else 
                    spi_state <= H_SCLK_IDLE;
            SCLK_EDGE :
                if(spi_edge_cnt == 'd15)
                    spi_state <= L_HALF_CYCLE;
                else 
                    spi_state <= H_SCLK_IDLE; 
            L_HALF_CYCLE:
                if(spi_sclk_cnt == 'd50)
                    spi_state <= ACK;
                else 
                    spi_state <= L_HALF_CYCLE;
            ACK       :spi_state <= ACK_WAIT;
            ACK_WAIT  :spi_state <= IDLE;
            default:spi_state <= IDLE;
        endcase
    end
end

//ds1302_sclk SPI_SLCK​时钟​翻转​
always@(posedge spi_clk or posedge spi_rst) begin
    if(spi_rst)
        ds1302_sclk <= 'd0;
    else if(spi_state == IDLE)
        ds1302_sclk <= SPI_CPOL;
    else if(spi_state == SCLK_EDGE)
        ds1302_sclk <= ~ds1302_sclk;
    else 
        ds1302_sclk <= ds1302_sclk;
end

//spi_sclk_cnt: SPI_SLCK​产生​分频​计数器​
always@(posedge spi_clk or posedge spi_rst) begin
    if(spi_rst)
        spi_sclk_cnt <= 'd0;
    else if(spi_state == IDLE)
        spi_sclk_cnt <= 'd0;
    else if(spi_state == H_SCLK_IDLE || spi_state == L_HALF_CYCLE)
        spi_sclk_cnt <= spi_sclk_cnt + 1'b1;
    else 
        spi_sclk_cnt <= 'd0;
end

//spi_edge_cnt:SPI_SCLK​边沿​计数器​
always@(posedge spi_clk or posedge spi_rst) begin
    if(spi_rst)
        spi_edge_cnt <= 'd0;
    else if(spi_state == IDLE)
        spi_edge_cnt <= 'd0;
    else if(spi_state == SCLK_EDGE)
        spi_edge_cnt <= spi_edge_cnt + 1'b1;
    else 
        spi_edge_cnt <= spi_edge_cnt;
end

//MOSI
always@(posedge spi_clk or posedge spi_rst) begin
    if(spi_rst)
        mosi_shift <= 'd0;
    else if(spi_state == IDLE && spi_wr_en)
        mosi_shift <= spi_data_in;
    else if((spi_state == SCLK_EDGE) && (SPI_CPHA == 1'b0) && (spi_edge_cnt[0] == 1'b1))
        mosi_shift <= {mosi_shift[6:0],mosi_shift[7]};
    else if((spi_state == SCLK_EDGE) && (SPI_CPHA == 1'b1) && (spi_edge_cnt[0] == 1'b0) && (spi_edge_cnt != 'd0))
        mosi_shift <= {mosi_shift[6:0],mosi_shift[7]};
end

//MISO
always@(posedge spi_clk or posedge spi_rst) begin
    if(spi_rst)
        miso_shift <= 'd0;
    else if(spi_state == IDLE && spi_wr_en)
        miso_shift <= 'd0;
    else if((spi_state == SCLK_EDGE) && (spi_edge_cnt[0] == 1'b0) && (SPI_CPHA == 1'b0))
        miso_shift <= {miso_shift[6:0],spi_miso};
    else if((spi_state == SCLK_EDGE) && (spi_edge_cnt[0] == 1'b1) && (SPI_CPHA == 1'b1))
        miso_shift <= {miso_shift[6:0],spi_miso};
end

endmodule

docs.title: W25Q128JVS
docs.text: W25Q128JVS ​是​一款​ SPI ​协议​的​ flash ​芯片​，​用于​固化​程序​；​官方​应该​不会​改动​这颗​ flash ​芯片​。

docs.title: DS1302
docs.text: RTC ​时钟​的​底层​代码​官方​封装​得​非常​好​，​使用​很​简单​；​由于​ DS1302 ​输出​的​是​ BCD ​码​数据​，​数码管​显示​反而​更加​简便​。

docs.title: 第一个
docs.text:
/*
    DS1302​数据传输​时​的​ ​读​、​写​ ​数据​转换​模块​
    1.​由于​DS1302​的​数据​手册​规定​数据传输​有限​LSB ​为了​对接​底层​的​SPI​的​MSB​优先​传输​的​规定​ ​故​增添​此​模块​用来​ ​数据​转换​
    2.​由于​DS1302​只有​一个​IO​端口​进行​数据传输​    ​而​底层​的​标准​SPI​接口​有​两个​数据​端口​    ​故​增添​此​模块​用来​ ​端口​转换​
    3.DS1302​是​通过​置​ ​高电平​ ​来​选择​通信​        ​与​标准​SPI​通信协议​逻辑​相反​                            
*/
module ds1302_io_convert
(  
    input  wire                         ds1302_clk                            , 
    input  wire                         ds1302_rst                            ,
//​写​
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        ds1302_write_addr                     , //​写​ ​数据​地址​
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        ds1302_write_data                     , //​写​ ​数据​
    input  wire                         ds1302_write_en                       , //​写​ ​使能​ 
    output wire                         ds1302_write_ack                      , //​写​ ​完整​写​过程​完成​
//​读​
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        ds1302_read_addr                      , //​读​ ​数据​地址​ 
    output reg         [   7: 0]        ds1302_read_data                      , //​读​ ​数据​
    input  wire                         ds1302_read_en                        , //​读​ ​使能​
    output wire                         ds1302_read_ack                       , //​读​ ​完整​读​过程​完成​
//DS1302​物理​IO
    output wire                         ds1302_ce                             , //​片选​端口​
    output wire                         ds1302_sclk                           , //SPI​时钟​
    inout  wire                         ds1302_data                             //​用于​构建​三态​门​
);


//​状态机​参数​定义​
    localparam                          IDLE                     = 0         ; //​空闲​状态​ 
    localparam                          CE_HIGH                  = 1         ; //​将​CE​拉高​

    localparam                          READ_ADDR                = 2         ; //​发送​读​地址​
    localparam                          READ_DATA                = 3         ; //​发送​读数据​

    localparam                          WRITE_ADDR               = 4         ; //​发送​写​地址​
    localparam                          WRITE_DATA               = 5         ; //​发送​写​数据​

    localparam                          ACK                      = 6         ; //​结束​ ​应答​
    localparam                          CE_LOW                   = 7         ; //​将​CE​拉低​

// Reg define
    reg                [   3: 0]        state                                ;

    reg                [  19: 0]        delay_cnt                            ;
    reg                                 cs_ctrl                              ;
    reg                                 wr_req                               ;
    reg                                 ds1302_io_ctrl                       ;
    reg                [   7: 0]        send_data                            ;

    wire                                ds1302_mosi                          ;//​输出​
    wire                                ds1302_miso                          ;//​输入​

    wire                                wr_ack                               ;
    wire               [   7: 0]        receive_data                         ;

    assign                              ds1302_data              = ~ds1302_io_ctrl ? ds1302_mosi       : 1'bz;
    assign                              ds1302_miso              =  ds1302_io_ctrl ? ds1302_data       : 1'b0;


assign                                  ds1302_read_ack          = (state == ACK);//​读完​数据​ ​应答​
assign                                  ds1302_write_ack         = (state == ACK);//​写​完​数据​ ​应答​

/****************************​第一段​状态机​ ​状态​逻辑​的​跳转​**************************************/
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        state <= IDLE;
    else begin
        case(state)
            IDLE       :
                if(ds1302_write_en || ds1302_read_en)
                    state <= CE_HIGH;
                else 
                    state <= IDLE;
            CE_HIGH    : //​将​CE​拉高​
                if(delay_cnt == 20'd255)
                    state <=  ds1302_read_en ? READ_ADDR :  WRITE_ADDR;
                else 
                    state <= CE_HIGH;

            READ_ADDR  : //​发送​读​地址​
                if(wr_ack)
                    state <= READ_DATA;
                else
                    state <= READ_ADDR;
            READ_DATA  :
                if(wr_ack)
                    state <= ACK;
                else 
                    state <= READ_DATA;

            WRITE_ADDR :
                if(wr_ack)
                    state <= WRITE_DATA;
                else 
                    state <= WRITE_ADDR;

            WRITE_DATA :
                if(wr_ack)
                    state <= ACK;
                else 
                    state <= WRITE_DATA;

            ACK        :  state <= CE_LOW;
            CE_LOW     :  
                if(delay_cnt == 20'd255)
                    state <= IDLE;
                else 
                    state <= CE_LOW;
            default:state <= IDLE;
        endcase
    end
end

/****************************​第二段​状态机​ ​信号​操作​**************************************/

//delay_cnt ​用于​提前​对​CS​片选​进行​一段时间​的​操作​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        delay_cnt <= 'd0;
    else if(state ==CE_HIGH || state ==CE_LOW)
        delay_cnt <= delay_cnt + 1'b1;
    else 
        delay_cnt <= 'd0 ;
end

//cs_ctrl ​控制​片选​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        cs_ctrl <= 'd0;
    else if(state == CE_HIGH)
        cs_ctrl <= 'd1;
    else if(state == CE_LOW)
        cs_ctrl <= 'd0 ;
    else 
        cs_ctrl <= cs_ctrl;
end

//wr_req ​传输​请求​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        wr_req <= 'd0;
    else if(wr_ack) 
        wr_req <= 'd0;
    else if(state == READ_ADDR || state == READ_DATA || state == WRITE_ADDR ||state == WRITE_DATA)
        wr_req <= 'd1;
    else 
        wr_req <= wr_req;
end

//ds1302_io_ctrl ​三态​门​控制​端口​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        ds1302_io_ctrl <= 1'b0;
    else
        ds1302_io_ctrl <= (state == READ_DATA);
end

//ds1302_read_data ​读取​到​的​8​位​数据​进行​数据​转换​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        ds1302_read_data <= 8'h00;
    else if(state == READ_DATA && wr_ack)
        ds1302_read_data <= {receive_data[0],receive_data[1],receive_data[2],receive_data[3],
                         receive_data[4],receive_data[5],receive_data[6],receive_data[7]};
end

//send_data:​发送​的​数据​进行​格式​转换​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        send_data <= 'd0;
    else if(state == READ_ADDR)
        send_data <= {ds1302_read_addr[0],ds1302_read_addr[1],ds1302_read_addr[2],ds1302_read_addr[3],
                        ds1302_read_addr[4],ds1302_read_addr[5],ds1302_read_addr[6],ds1302_read_addr[7]};
    else if(state == WRITE_ADDR)
        send_data <= {ds1302_write_addr[0],ds1302_write_addr[1],ds1302_write_addr[2],ds1302_write_addr[3],
                        ds1302_write_addr[4],ds1302_write_addr[5],ds1302_write_addr[6],ds1302_write_addr[7]};
        else if(state == WRITE_DATA)
        send_data <= {ds1302_write_data[0],ds1302_write_data[1],ds1302_write_data[2],ds1302_write_data[3],
                        ds1302_write_data[4],ds1302_write_data[5],ds1302_write_data[6],ds1302_write_data[7]};
end


spi_master#(
    .SYS_CLK                             (28'd50_000_000          ),
    .SPI_SCLK                            (28'd100_000             ),
    .SPI_CPOL                            (1'b0                    ),
    .SPI_CPHA                            (1'b0                    ) 
)
spi_master_inst(
    .spi_clk                             (ds1302_clk              ),
    .spi_rst                             (ds1302_rst              ),
    .spi_cs_ctrl                         (cs_ctrl                 ),// ​片选​控制​端口​
    .spi_wr_en                           (wr_req                  ),// ​传输​使能​
    .spi_data_in                         (send_data               ),// ​数据​输入​
    .spi_data_out                        (receive_data            ),// ​数据​输出​
    .spi_wr_ack                          (wr_ack                  ),// ​传输​结束​应答​
//SPI​物理​端口​
    .ds1302_ce                           (ds1302_ce               ),// ​片选​端口​
    .ds1302_sclk                         (ds1302_sclk             ),// SPI​时钟​
    .spi_mosi                            (ds1302_mosi             ),// ​用​三态​门​进行​构建​
    .spi_miso                            (ds1302_miso             ) 
);

endmodule

docs.title: 第二个
docs.text:
/*
    DS1302​完整​ ​读​、​写​传输​  ​控制​模块​
*/
module ds1302_wr_drive(
    input  wire                         ds1302_clk               ,
    input  wire                         ds1302_rst               ,

//​用户​写​数据​接口​
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        write_second             ,
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        write_minute             ,
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        write_hour               ,
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        write_date               ,
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        write_month              ,
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        write_week               ,
    input  wire        [   7: 0]        write_year               ,

    input  wire                         write_time_req           ,//​完整​写​操作​的​     ​写​请求​
    output wire                         write_time_ack           ,//​完整​读​操作​完成​   ​应答​信号​

//​用户​读数据​接口​
    output reg         [   7: 0]        read_second             ,
    output reg         [   7: 0]        read_minute             ,
    output reg         [   7: 0]        read_hour               ,
    output reg         [   7: 0]        read_date               ,
    output reg         [   7: 0]        read_month              ,
    output reg         [   7: 0]        read_week               ,
    output reg         [   7: 0]        read_year               ,

    input  wire                         read_time_req            ,//​完整​读​操作​的​ ​读​请求​
    output wire                         read_time_ack            ,//​完整​读​操作​完成​ ​应答​信号​

//DS1302​物理​IO
    output wire                         ds1302_ce                ,//DS1302 ​复位​引脚​
    output wire                         ds1302_sclk              ,//DS1302 ​时钟​引脚​
    inout  wire                         ds1302_data               //DS1302 ​双向​数据​引脚​  
);

//​状态机​ ​状态​定义​
    localparam                          IDLE                     = 0     ;
//​写​状态​
    localparam                          WRITE_WP                 = 1     ;//​写​保护​ 
    localparam                          WRITE_YEAR               = 2     ;
    localparam                          WRITE_WEEK               = 3     ;
    localparam                          WRITE_MON                = 4     ;
    localparam                          WRITE_DATE               = 5     ;
    localparam                          WRITE_HOUR               = 6     ;
    localparam                          WRITE_MIN                = 7     ;
    localparam                          WRITE_SEC                = 8     ;
//​读状态​
    localparam                          READ_YEAR                = 9     ;
    localparam                          READ_WEEK                = 10    ;
    localparam                          READ_MON                 = 11    ;
    localparam                          READ_DATE                = 12    ;
    localparam                          READ_HOUR                = 13    ;
    localparam                          READ_MIN                 = 14    ;
    localparam                          READ_SEC                 = 15    ;
    localparam                          ACK                      = 16    ;  

//​状态机​
    reg                [   4: 0]        state                     ;
//​写​
    reg                [   7: 0]        write_addr                ;//​写​ ​数据​地址​
    reg                [   7: 0]        write_data                ;//​写​ ​数据​
    reg                                 write_req                 ;//​写​ ​请求​
    wire                                write_req_ack             ;//​写​ ​完整​写​操作​ ​完成​应答​信号​

//​读​
    reg                [   7: 0]        read_addr                 ;//​读​ ​数据​地址​
    wire               [   7: 0]        read_data                 ;//​读​ ​数据​
    reg                                 read_req                  ;//​读​ ​请求​
    wire                                read_req_ack              ;//​读​ ​完整​读​操作​ ​完成​应答​信号​

    assign                              write_time_ack            = (state == ACK); //​完整​写​数据​ ​完成​ ​应答​脉冲​
    assign                              read_time_ack             = (state == ACK); //​完整​读数据​ ​完整​ ​应答​脉冲​


/****************************​第一段​状态机​ ​状态​逻辑​的​跳转​**************************************/

//​状态机​第一段​  ​写​、​读数据​状态机​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        state <= IDLE;
    else begin 
        case(state)
            IDLE      : state <= write_time_req ? WRITE_WP  : 
                                 read_time_req  ? READ_YEAR : IDLE  ;
            WRITE_WP  : state <= write_req_ack ? WRITE_YEAR : WRITE_WP   ;
            WRITE_YEAR: state <= write_req_ack ? WRITE_WEEK : WRITE_YEAR ;
            WRITE_WEEK: state <= write_req_ack ? WRITE_MON  : WRITE_WEEK ;
            WRITE_MON : state <= write_req_ack ? WRITE_DATE : WRITE_MON  ;
            WRITE_DATE: state <= write_req_ack ? WRITE_HOUR : WRITE_DATE ;
            WRITE_HOUR: state <= write_req_ack ? WRITE_MIN  : WRITE_HOUR ;
            WRITE_MIN : state <= write_req_ack ? WRITE_SEC  : WRITE_MIN  ;
            WRITE_SEC : state <= write_req_ack ? ACK        : WRITE_SEC  ;

            READ_YEAR: state <= read_req_ack  ? READ_WEEK : READ_YEAR ;
            READ_WEEK: state <= read_req_ack  ? READ_MON  : READ_WEEK ;
            READ_MON : state <= read_req_ack  ? READ_DATE : READ_MON  ;
            READ_DATE: state <= read_req_ack  ? READ_HOUR : READ_DATE ;
            READ_HOUR: state <= read_req_ack  ? READ_MIN  : READ_HOUR ;
            READ_MIN : state <= read_req_ack  ? READ_SEC  : READ_MIN  ;
            READ_SEC : state <= read_req_ack  ? ACK       : READ_SEC  ;

            ACK      : state <= IDLE;
            default  : state <= IDLE;
        endcase
    end
end


/****************************​第二段​状态机​ ​写​状态​下​操作​**************************************/

//write_req ​在​以下​状态​下​ ​启动​write​操作​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        write_req <= 1'b0;
    else if(write_req_ack)
        write_req <= 1'b0;
    else
        case(state)
            WRITE_WP  ,
            WRITE_YEAR,
            WRITE_WEEK,
            WRITE_MON ,
            WRITE_DATE,
            WRITE_HOUR,
            WRITE_MIN ,
            WRITE_SEC : write_req <= 1'b1; 
        endcase
end

//​写​操作​下​ ​在​不同​写​状态​下​对​ ​地址​、​数据​ ​进行​赋值​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)begin
            write_addr <= 8'h00;
            write_data <= 8'h00;
    end
    else
        case(state)
            WRITE_WP  :begin write_addr <= 8'h8e; write_data <= 8'h00        ; end
            WRITE_YEAR:begin write_addr <= 8'h8c; write_data <= write_year   ; end
            WRITE_WEEK:begin write_addr <= 8'h8a; write_data <= write_week   ; end
            WRITE_MON :begin write_addr <= 8'h88; write_data <= write_month  ; end
            WRITE_DATE:begin write_addr <= 8'h86; write_data <= write_date   ; end
            WRITE_HOUR:begin write_addr <= 8'h84; write_data <= write_hour   ; end
            WRITE_MIN :begin write_addr <= 8'h82; write_data <= write_minute ; end
            WRITE_SEC :begin write_addr <= 8'h80; write_data <= write_second ; end
            default   :begin write_addr <= 8'h00; write_data <= 8'h00        ; end
        endcase
end


/****************************​第二段​状态机​ ​读状态​下​操作​**************************************/

//read_req ​在​以下​状态​下​ ​启动​read​操作​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        read_req <= 1'b0;
    else if(read_req_ack)
        read_req <= 1'b0;
    else
        case(state)
            READ_YEAR ,
            READ_WEEK ,
            READ_MON  ,
            READ_DATE ,
            READ_HOUR ,
            READ_MIN  ,
            READ_SEC  : read_req <= 1'b1;
        endcase
end


//​读取数据​时​ ​需要​先​发送​的​ ​数据​地址​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)
        read_addr <= 8'h00;
    else
        case(state)
            READ_YEAR : read_addr <= 8'h8d;
            READ_WEEK : read_addr <= 8'h8b;
            READ_MON  : read_addr <= 8'h89;
            READ_DATE : read_addr <= 8'h87;
            READ_HOUR : read_addr <= 8'h85;
            READ_MIN  : read_addr <= 8'h83;
            READ_SEC  : read_addr <= 8'h81;
            default   : read_addr <= read_addr;
        endcase
end

//​在读​应答​时​ ​将​接收​要​读取​的​数据​
always@(posedge ds1302_clk or posedge ds1302_rst)   begin
    if(ds1302_rst)begin
        read_year   <= 8'h00;
        read_week   <= 8'h00;
        read_month  <= 8'h00;
        read_date   <= 8'h00;
        read_hour   <= 8'h00;
        read_minute <= 8'h00;
        read_second <= 8'h00;
    end
    else if(read_req_ack) begin
        case(state)
            READ_YEAR : read_year   <=  read_data ;    
            READ_WEEK : read_week   <=  read_data ;
            READ_MON  : read_month  <=  read_data ; 
            READ_DATE : read_date   <=  read_data ;
            READ_HOUR : read_hour   <=  read_data ;
            READ_MIN  : read_minute <=  read_data ;  
            READ_SEC  : read_second <=  read_data ;  
        endcase
    end
end


//ds1302 module
ds1302_io_convert ds1302_io_convert_inst(
.ds1302_clk                             (ds1302_clk              ),
.ds1302_rst                             (ds1302_rst              ),
//​写​
.ds1302_write_addr                      (write_addr              ),// ​写​ ​数据​地址​
.ds1302_write_data                      (write_data              ),// ​写​ ​数据​
.ds1302_write_en                        (write_req               ),// ​写​ ​使能​
.ds1302_write_ack                       (write_req_ack           ),// ​写​ ​完整​写​过程​完成​
//​读​
.ds1302_read_addr                       (read_addr               ),// ​读​ ​数据​地址​
.ds1302_read_data                       (read_data               ),// ​读​ ​数据​
.ds1302_read_en                         (read_req                ),// ​读​ ​使能​
.ds1302_read_ack                        (read_req_ack            ),// ​读​ ​完整​读​过程​完成​
//DS1302​物理​IO
.ds1302_ce                              (ds1302_ce               ),
.ds1302_sclk                            (ds1302_sclk             ),
.ds1302_data                            (ds1302_data             )
);

endmodule

module ds1302_ctrl (
    input             sys_clk     ,
    input             sys_rst     ,
    output wire [7:0] read_second ,
    output wire [7:0] read_minute ,
    output wire [7:0] read_hour   ,
    output wire       ds1302_ce   ,
    output wire       ds1302_sclk ,
    inout  wire       ds1302_data
);    



localparam WRITE_SEC   = 8'h11;   // 11​秒​
localparam WRITE_MIN   = 8'h11;   // 11​分​
localparam WRITE_HOUR  = 8'h00;   // 0​时​（24​小时​制​）



reg         write_time_req;        // ​写​请求​（​脉冲​）
wire        write_time_ack;        // ​写​完成​应答​
reg         read_time_req;         // ​读​请求​（​持续​高​）
// wire        read_time_ack;         // ​读​完成​应答​（​每轮读​完成​时​有效​）

reg [1:0] state;
localparam ST_IDLE      = 2'd0,
           ST_WRITE     = 2'd1,
           ST_READ_CONT = 2'd2;
           
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst) begin
        state          <= ST_IDLE;
        write_time_req <= 1'b0;
        read_time_req  <= 1'b0;
    end
    else begin
        case (state)
            ST_IDLE : begin
                // ​复位​后​立即​发起​写​请求​
                state          <= ST_WRITE;
                write_time_req <= 1'b1;
                read_time_req  <= 1'b0;
            end

            ST_WRITE : begin
                if (write_time_ack) begin
                    // ​写​完成​，​切换​到​持续​读状态​
                    state          <= ST_READ_CONT;
                    write_time_req <= 1'b0;
                    read_time_req  <= 1'b1;   // ​读使​能​一直​拉高​
                end
                else begin
                    write_time_req <= 1'b1;   // ​保持​写​请求​
                    read_time_req  <= 1'b0;
                end
            end



            ST_READ_CONT : begin
                // ​读​永远​使能​
                read_time_req <= 1'b1;
                state         <= ST_READ_CONT;
            end



            default : begin
                state          <= ST_IDLE;
                write_time_req <= 1'b0;
                read_time_req  <= 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end



ds1302_wr_drive u_ds1302_wr_drive(
    .ds1302_clk         ( sys_clk         ),
    .ds1302_rst         ( sys_rst         ),
    .write_second       ( WRITE_SEC       ),
    .write_minute       ( WRITE_MIN       ),
    .write_hour         ( WRITE_HOUR      ),
    .write_date         (                 ),
    .write_month        (                 ),
    .write_week         (                 ),
    .write_year         (                 ),
    .write_time_req     ( write_time_req  ),
    .write_time_ack     ( write_time_ack  ),
    .read_second        ( read_second     ),
    .read_minute        ( read_minute     ),
    .read_hour          ( read_hour       ),
    .read_date          (                 ),
    .read_month         (                 ),
    .read_week          (                 ),
    .read_year          (                 ),
    .read_time_req      ( read_time_req   ),
    .read_time_ack      (                 ),
    .ds1302_ce          ( ds1302_ce       ),
    .ds1302_sclk        ( ds1302_sclk     ),

);

docs.title: 数码管​显示​模块
docs.text:
module seg (
    input  wire         sys_clk    ,
    input  wire         sys_rst    ,
    input  wire  [31:0] display_num,
    output reg   [7:0]  seg_out    ,
    output reg   [7:0]  com_out    
);

localparam SEG_0 = 8'hC0       ,
           SEG_1 = 8'hF9       ,
           SEG_2 = 8'hA4       ,
           SEG_3 = 8'hB0       ,
           SEG_4 = 8'h99       ,
           SEG_5 = 8'h92       ,
           SEG_6 = 8'h82       ,
           SEG_7 = 8'hF8       ,
           SEG_8 = 8'h80       ,
           SEG_9 = 8'h90       ,
           SEG_A = 8'h88       ,
           SEG_b = 8'h83       ,
           SEG_C = 8'hC6       ,
           SEG_d = 8'hA1       ,
           SEG_E = 8'h86       ,
           SEG_F = 8'h8E       ,
           SEG__ = 8'b1011_1111,
           SEGOFF= 8'hff       ;

// 20 * (1000 * 50)
// parameter CLK_CNT_1MS = 16'd50_000 - 1'd1;
parameter CLK_CNT_1MS = 16'd49_999;
reg   [15:0] clk_cnt        ;
reg   [7 :0] seg_reg [0:7]  ;

// 1ms
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    else if (clk_cnt == CLK_CNT_1MS)
        clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    else
        clk_cnt <= clk_cnt + 1'd1;
end

function [7:0] num_to_seg;
    input [3:0] data;
        case (data)
            4'h0: num_to_seg = SEG_0;
            4'h1: num_to_seg = SEG_1;
            4'h2: num_to_seg = SEG_2;
            4'h3: num_to_seg = SEG_3;
            4'h4: num_to_seg = SEG_4;
            4'h5: num_to_seg = SEG_5;
            4'h6: num_to_seg = SEG_6;
            4'h7: num_to_seg = SEG_7;
            4'h8: num_to_seg = SEG_8;
            4'h9: num_to_seg = SEG_9;
            4'hA: num_to_seg = SEG_A;
            4'hb: num_to_seg = SEG_b;
            4'hc: num_to_seg = SEG_C;
            4'hd: num_to_seg = SEG_d;
            4'hE: num_to_seg = SEG_E;
            4'hF: num_to_seg = SEG_F;
        endcase
endfunction

always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst) begin
        seg_reg [0] <= SEGOFF;
        seg_reg [1] <= SEGOFF;
        seg_reg [2] <= SEGOFF;
        seg_reg [3] <= SEGOFF;
        seg_reg [4] <= SEGOFF;
        seg_reg [5] <= SEGOFF;
        seg_reg [6] <= SEGOFF;
        seg_reg [7] <= SEGOFF;
    end
    else begin // 
        seg_reg [0] <= num_to_seg(display_num[3 : 0]);
        seg_reg [1] <= num_to_seg(display_num[7 : 4]);
        seg_reg [2] <= SEG__;
        seg_reg [3] <= num_to_seg(display_num[15:12]);
        seg_reg [4] <= num_to_seg(display_num[19:16]);
        seg_reg [5] <= SEG__;
        seg_reg [6] <= num_to_seg(display_num[27:24]);
        seg_reg [7] <= num_to_seg(display_num[31:28]);
    end 
end

always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst) begin
        com_out <= 8'b1111_1110;
        seg_out <= SEGOFF      ;
    end
    else if (clk_cnt == CLK_CNT_1MS) begin
        com_out <= {com_out[6:0],com_out[7]};
    end else begin
        case(com_out)
            8'b1111_1110: seg_out <= seg_reg [7] ; 
            8'b1111_1101: seg_out <= seg_reg [6] ; 
            8'b1111_1011: seg_out <= seg_reg [5] ; 
            8'b1111_0111: seg_out <= seg_reg [4] ; 
            8'b1110_1111: seg_out <= seg_reg [3] ; 
            8'b1101_1111: seg_out <= seg_reg [2] ; 
            8'b1011_1111: seg_out <= seg_reg [1] ; 
            8'b0111_1111: seg_out <= seg_reg [0] ; 
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

docs.title: 第七​部分​　SDRAM ​与​加餐​知识
SDRAM
docs.text: ​没​准备​这个​。

docs.title: 一​、​问题
docs.text:
​我们​有​二进制​数​，​比如​：

  • ​二进制​：1101（​十进制​ 13）
  • ​我们​需要​显示​：​两个​数码管​，​分别​显示​ 1 ​和​ 3
  • ​数码管​需要​ BCD ​码​输入​：0001（1）​和​ 0011（3）

​问题​：​如何​把​ 1101 ​变成​ 0001 0011？

docs.title: 二​、​模拟​十进制​计算
docs.text:
​假设​要​计算​二进制​ 1101(13) ​的​十进制​表示​：

​手动​计算​过程​：
​从​最高​位​开始​：
1. ​读入​第一位​1：​当前​值​ = 1
2. ​读入​第二位​1：​当前​值​ = 1×2 + 1 = 3
3. ​读入​第三位​0：​当前​值​ = 3×2 + 0 = 6
4. ​读入​第四位​1：​当前​值​ = 6×2 + 1 = 13

​结果​：13

Double Dabble ​算法​就是​在​硬件​上​模拟​这个​过程​。

docs.title: 1. ​用​移位​代替​乘法
docs.text:
• ​左移​ 1 ​位​ = ​乘以​ 2
  • ​右移​ 1 ​位​ = ​除以​ 2

docs.title: 五​、​为什么​加​3？
docs.text:
​想象​一个​十进制​数字​，​比如​ 6：

  • ​如果​乘以​ 2：6×2=12
  • ​在​ BCD ​中​，​这​应该​表示​为​ 0001 0010（1 ​和​ 2）

​但​如果​我们​直接​左移​二进制​ 6(0110)：

  • 0110 ​左移​ = 1100（​这是​ 12，​但​ 1100 ​是​十六进制​ C，​不是​有效​ BCD）

​如果​加三​的话​：

  • 6(0110) + 3 = 9(1001)
  • 9(1001) ​左移​ = 1 0010（​移位​后​成为​两个​ 4 ​位​：0001 0010）
  • ​这​正是​ 1 ​和​ 2，​即​ 12

​为什么​加​3，​而​不是​别的​数字​？

​对于​数字​ N（0-9）：

  • ​如果​ N<5：​左移​后​ 2N<10，​不会​进位​
  • ​如果​ N≥5：​左移​后​ 2N≥10，​需要​进位​

​加​3​的​作用​：

​当​ N≥5 ​时​，N+3≥8

  • (N+3)×2 = 2N+6
  • 2N≥10，​所以​ 2N+6≥16

​关键​：2N+6 ​在​二进制​中​会​产生​进位​。

​比如​ N=5：

  • ​不​加​ 3：5(0101) ​左移​ → 1010（10，​但​ 1010 ​不是​有效​ BCD）
  • ​加​ 3：5+3=8(1000) ​左移​ → 0001 0110（16，​即​ 1 ​和​ 6）

​注意​ ​注意​理解​进位​的​含义​：​二进制​进位​是​指​二进制​进​四位​，​十进制​的​进位​也​是​指​二进制​数值​进位​四位​。

docs.title: 六​、​最​简洁​的​解释
docs.text:
​一句​话​解释​：

​从​二进制​最高​位​开始​，​每次​取​一位​。​在​左移​放入​这​一位​之前​，​先​检查​每个​ BCD ​位​，​如果​ ≥5 ​就加​ 3（​为​即将​到来​的​ ×2 ​可能​产生​的​进位​做​准备​），​然后​左移​所有​位​，​把​新位​放入​最低​位​。

​用​数学​表示​：

​对于​每个​ BCD ​位​（4 ​位​表示​ 0-9）：

  • ​如果​值​≥5：​值​ = ​值​ + 3
  • ​然后​所有​位​左移​ 1 ​位​，​移入​新​的​二进制位​

​为什么​叫​"Double Dabble"：

  • Double：​每次​操作​都​涉及​ ×2（​左移​）
  • Dabble：​轻轻​调整​（​加​ 3 ​的​调整​）

docs.title: 七​、​硬件​实现​的​优势
docs.text:
1. ​只​需要​简单​操作​：
    • ​比较​（≥5？）
    • ​加法​（+3）
    • ​移位​
  2. ​可​并行处理​：​所有​ BCD ​位​可以​同时​检查​是否​ ≥5
  3. ​确定性​的​循环​次数​：n ​位​二进制​数​需要​ n ​次​循环​

docs.title: 八​、​总结
docs.text:
​简单​记忆​：

  1. ​从​二进制​最高​位​开始​处理​
  2. ​每次​处理​前​，​检查​所有​ BCD ​位​
  3. ​如果​某​ BCD ​位​ ≥5，​就加​ 3
  4. ​所有​位​左移​ 1 ​位​，​移入​新​的​二进制位​
  5. ​重复​直到​处理​完​所有​二进制位​

​关键​理解​：

  • ​加​ 3 ​是​为了​处理​左移​（×2）​可能​产生​的​十进制​进位​
  • ​算法​模拟​了​"​从​高位​开始​，​逐位​构建​十进制​数​"​的​过程​
  • ​硬件​友好​：​只有​比较​、​加法​、​移位​

​这个​算法​的​精妙​之​处​在于​用​简单​的​操作​完成​了​复杂​的​进制​转换​，​特别​适合​硬件​实现​。​虽然​理解​起来​需要​一些​思考​，​但​一旦​理解​了​，​就​会​看到​它​的​简洁​和​高效​。

docs.title: Double Dabble ​的​ Verilog ​实现
docs.text:
​这​段​代码​是​笔者​后来​写​的​，​有些​题目​中​没用过​。

module hex_to_bcd # (
    parameter HEX_NUM_BIT = 8,
    // parameter DATA  = 4, // Quartus​软件​可以​声明​变量​来​实现​
    parameter BCD_NUM_BIT = 8
)(
    input  wire                       sys_clk,
    input  wire                       sys_rst,
    input  wire [HEX_NUM_BIT - 1 : 0] hex_num,
    output reg  [BCD_NUM_BIT - 1 : 0] bcd_num
    );

localparam SHIFT_WEI   = BCD_NUM_BIT + HEX_NUM_BIT; // ​左移​的​位数​
localparam CNT_MAX     = HEX_NUM_BIT + 1; // ​计数​次数​
// ​获取​位​宽​，​仅限​Vivado，​如果​你​是​Quartus​软件​可以​声明​变量​来​实现​
localparam DATA = $clog2(CNT_MAX);

reg [DATA - 1:0]         cnt_shift ;
reg [SHIFT_WEI - 1 : 0]  data_shift; // ​位移​寄存器​
// ​位移​标志​位​ 
reg                      shift_flag;

// ​位移​计数器​
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        cnt_shift <= {DATA{1'd0}};
    else if ((cnt_shift == CNT_MAX) && shift_flag)
        cnt_shift <= {DATA{1'd0}};
    else if (shift_flag)
        cnt_shift <= cnt_shift + 1'd1;
end
// ​位移​还是​比较​生成器​
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        shift_flag <= 1'b0;
    else
        shift_flag <= ~shift_flag;
end

integer i;
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        data_shift <= {SHIFT_WEI{1'd0}};
    else begin
        if (cnt_shift == 0)
            data_shift <= {{BCD_NUM_BIT{1'd0}},hex_num};
        // ​加​3​判断​阶段​（shift_flag=0）
        else if ((cnt_shift <= HEX_NUM_BIT) && (shift_flag == 1'b0)) begin
            // ​对​每个​BCD​位​（​每​4​位​一组​）​判断​是否​大于​4
            for (i = 0; i < BCD_NUM_BIT / 4 ; i = i + 1) begin
                // [a + ,b ]​从​ a ​开始​向上​取​ b ​位​
                if (data_shift[HEX_NUM_BIT + i*4 +: 4] > 4'd4) begin
                    data_shift[HEX_NUM_BIT + i*4 +: 4] <= 
                    data_shift[HEX_NUM_BIT + i*4 +: 4] + 4'd3;
                end
            end
        // ​左移​阶段​（shift_flag=1） 
        end else if ((cnt_shift <= HEX_NUM_BIT) && (shift_flag == 1'b1)) begin
            data_shift <= data_shift << 1;
        end
    end
end

// ​当​计数器​达到​最大值​时​，​输出​高​BCD_NUM_BIT​位​作为​结果​
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        bcd_num <= {BCD_NUM_BIT{1'b0}};
    else if (cnt_shift == CNT_MAX)
        bcd_num <= data_shift[SHIFT_WEI-1 : HEX_NUM_BIT]; // ​取出​BCD​部分​
end

endmodule

docs.title: 迟滞
docs.text: ​就是​在​原有​上​下限​之外​再​设置​一组​上​下限​，​作用​类似​于​斯密​特​触发器​，​用来​降低​毛刺​信号​导致​的​问题​。​这部分​内容​在​江协​的​ 51 ​单片机​部分​有​涉及​，​感兴趣​可以​去​看看​。

docs.title: 第八​部分​　​综合​实例​（​一​）：​按键​+​数码管​+​串口​+LED、​按键​+​数码管​+AT24C02
按键​+​数码管​+​串口​+LED

​要求​ s1​按下​数值​增加​1，s2​按下​数值​增加​10，s3​按下​减​1，s4​按下​减​10；​如果​超出​255​或者​小于​零​，​所有​LED​双闪​一次​。 ​串口​以​115200​波特率​输出​数值​，​数值​结尾​要​以​回车​结尾​；​数码管​显示​数值​，​高位​为​0​时要​保证​灭灯​。

​这个​练习​是​笔者​自己​写​的​，​难度​较大​；​耐心​做​完会​深刻理解​上述​四个​模块​的​写法​，​很​利于​巩固​和​综合​。​模块​可以​复用​，​因为​现在​刚​开始​，​等​后面​做​题​熟练​之后​就​可以​自己​写​了​。

  • ​数码管​部分​参考​：SEG​数码管​

  • ​过程​中​采用​了​ Double Dabble ​算法​。

​由于​是​练习​，​这里​只​采用​最​便于​拓展​的​写法​；​这​段​代码​本​可以​做​得​更​精细​，​但​那样​就​违背​了​练习​的​初衷​。

​下面​是​代码​实现​：

docs.text: ​代码​部分​由​一个​顶层​模块​和​四个​基础​模块​组成​。

docs.title: uart_tx
docs.text:
​和​ UART_TX ​的​写法​一致​。

module uart_tx(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [7:0] tx_data,
    input wire tx_en,
    output reg tx_busy,
    output reg tx
    );

parameter CLK_Hz = 50_000_000;
parameter BPS    = 115200;
localparam CNT_MAX = CLK_Hz / BPS;

reg [7:0] tx_data_reg;
reg [15:0] clk_cnt;
reg [3:0] bit_cnt;

// ​波特率​发生器​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if(rst) begin
        clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    end else if ( tx_busy )begin
        if (clk_cnt < CNT_MAX - 1) clk_cnt <= clk_cnt + 16'd1;
        else clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    end else begin
        clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    end
end

// ​发送​位数​计数器​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if(rst) begin
        bit_cnt <= 4'd0;
    end else if ( tx_busy )begin
        if (clk_cnt == CNT_MAX - 1) bit_cnt <= bit_cnt + 4'd1;
//        else bit_cnt <= 4'd0;
    end else begin
        bit_cnt <= 4'd0;
    end
end

// ​忙​信号​发生器​和​输入​信号​寄存器​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if(rst) begin
        tx_busy <= 1'd0;
        tx_data_reg <= 8'd0;
    end else if( tx_en && !tx_busy )begin
        tx_busy <= 1'd1;    
        tx_data_reg <= tx_data;
    end else if (clk_cnt == CNT_MAX - CNT_MAX / 16 && bit_cnt == 4'd9) begin
        tx_busy <= 1'd0;
        tx_data_reg <= 8'd0;
    end
end

// ​串行​转​并行​逻辑​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if(rst) begin
        tx <= 1'd1; // ​初始​信号​为​高电平​
    end else if( tx_busy ) begin
        if(clk_cnt == CNT_MAX / 2 - 1) begin
            case (bit_cnt)
                4'd0: tx <= 1'd0;
                4'd1: tx <= tx_data_reg[0];
                4'd2: tx <= tx_data_reg[1];
                4'd3: tx <= tx_data_reg[2];
                4'd4: tx <= tx_data_reg[3];
                4'd5: tx <= tx_data_reg[4];
                4'd6: tx <= tx_data_reg[5];
                4'd7: tx <= tx_data_reg[6];
                4'd8: tx <= tx_data_reg[7];
                4'd9: tx <= 1'd1;
                default : tx <= 1'd1;
            endcase
        end
    end else tx <= 1'd1; // ​初始​信号​为​高电平​
end

endmodule

docs.title: led_flicker
docs.text:
​简单​的​灯​双闪​逻辑​

module led_flicker(
    input wire clk,  
    input wire rst,   
    input wire led_start,
    output reg [7:0] led_out
    );

// 200ms​计时器​
localparam CNT_MAX = 24'd10_000_000;
reg [1:0]  led_fil_cnt;
reg        led_fil_flg;
reg [23:0] clk_cnt;

// ​计时​200ms​用于​闪烁​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        clk_cnt <= 24'd0;
    end else if(led_fil_flg)begin
        if ( clk_cnt < CNT_MAX - 24'd1) begin
            clk_cnt <= clk_cnt + 24'd1;
        end else begin
            clk_cnt <= 24'd0;
        end
    end else begin
        clk_cnt <= 24'd0;
    end
end

// ​闪烁​两次​逻辑​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        led_fil_cnt <= 2'b0;
        led_out     <= 8'b1111_1111;
        led_fil_flg <= 1'b0;
    end else if ( led_fil_cnt == 2'd3 && clk_cnt ==  CNT_MAX - 24'd1) begin
        // ​防止​如果​一直​高电平​卡死​，​如果​一直​高电平​会​一直​闪烁​
        led_fil_cnt <= 2'b0;
        led_fil_flg <= 1'b0;
        led_out     <= 8'b1111_1111;
    end else if (led_start && !led_fil_flg) begin
        led_fil_flg <= 1'd1;
    end else if ( led_fil_flg && clk_cnt ==  CNT_MAX - 24'd1 && led_fil_cnt < 2'd3 ) begin
        led_fil_cnt <= led_fil_cnt + 2'd1;
        led_out <= ~led_out;              
    end else begin
        led_fil_cnt <= led_fil_cnt;        
        led_fil_flg <= led_fil_flg;        
        led_out     <= led_out;
    end
end

endmodule

docs.title: key
docs.text:
​和​ Key_​短按​的​写法​一致​。

module key(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [3:0] key_in,
    output reg [3:0] key_val
    );

// 20ns ​一个​时钟​周期​ 10ms
localparam CNT_MAX = 20'd500_000;

reg  [3:0] key_in_0;
reg  [3:0] key_in_1;
reg  [3:0] key_reg_0;
reg  [3:0] key_reg_1;
reg [19:0] clk_cnt;

// ​计时​10ms​进行​消抖​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        clk_cnt <= 20'd0;
    end else if ( clk_cnt < CNT_MAX - 20'd1) begin
        clk_cnt <= clk_cnt + 20'd1;
    end else begin
        clk_cnt <= 20'd0;
    end
end

// ​消除​亚稳态​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        key_in_0 <= 4'b1111;
        key_in_1 <= 4'b1111;
    end else begin
        key_in_0 <= key_in;
        key_in_1 <= key_in_0;
    end
end

// ​每隔​10ms​取​一次​结果​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        key_reg_0 <= 4'b1111;
        key_reg_1 <= 4'b1111;
        key_val   <= 4'd0;
    end else if (clk_cnt == CNT_MAX - 20'd1)begin
        key_reg_0 <= key_in_1;
        key_reg_1 <= key_reg_0;
        key_val <= ~key_reg_0 & key_reg_1;
    end else begin
        key_val <= 4'd0;
    end
end

endmodule

docs.title: seg
docs.text:
​和​ SEG​数码管​的​写法​一致​。

module seg(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [31:0] disp_num,// 32​位​显示​数字​，​每​4​位​代表​一个​十六进制​数​
    input wire [7:0]  blank_en, // ​灭​零​控制​信号​，​对应​8​个​数码管​，1​表示​灭​零​
    input wire [7:0]  piont_en, // ​小数点​控制​信号​，​对应​8​个​数码管​，1​表示​显示​
    output reg [7:0]  com_io,
    output reg [7:0]  seg_io
    );

// 1ms
localparam CNT_MAX = 16'd50_000;// 50MHz / 1000Hz = 50000
localparam SEG_0   = 8'b0000_0011; // 0
localparam SEG_1   = 8'b1001_1111; // 1
localparam SEG_2   = 8'b0010_0101; // 2
localparam SEG_3   = 8'b0000_1101; // 3
localparam SEG_4   = 8'b1001_1001; // 4
localparam SEG_5   = 8'b0100_1001; // 5
localparam SEG_6   = 8'b0100_0001; // 6
localparam SEG_7   = 8'b0001_1111; // 7
localparam SEG_8   = 8'b0000_0001; // 8
localparam SEG_9   = 8'b0000_1001; // 9
localparam SEG_A   = 8'b0001_0001; // A
localparam SEG_B   = 8'b1100_0001; // b
localparam SEG_C   = 8'b0110_0011; // C
localparam SEG_D   = 8'b1000_0101; // d
localparam SEG_E   = 8'b0110_0001; // E
localparam SEG_F   = 8'b0111_0001; // F
localparam SEG_OFF = 8'b1111_1111; // ​全灭​
localparam SEG_PIN = 8'b1111_1110;

reg [15:0] clk_cnt;      // 1ms​计时​计数器​
reg [7:0] seg_reg [0:7]; // 8​个​数码管​的​段码​数据​（​并行​存储​）

// ​段码​转换​函数​,​用于​通过​数值​来​找​段​码表​
function [7:0] hex_to_seg;
    input [3:0] hex_data;
    begin
        case (hex_data)
            4'd0: hex_to_seg = SEG_0;
            4'd1: hex_to_seg = SEG_1;
            4'd2: hex_to_seg = SEG_2;
            4'd3: hex_to_seg = SEG_3;
            4'd4: hex_to_seg = SEG_4;
            4'd5: hex_to_seg = SEG_5;
            4'd6: hex_to_seg = SEG_6;
            4'd7: hex_to_seg = SEG_7;
            4'd8: hex_to_seg = SEG_8;
            4'd9: hex_to_seg = SEG_9;
            4'd10: hex_to_seg = SEG_A;
            4'd11: hex_to_seg = SEG_B;
            4'd12: hex_to_seg = SEG_C;
            4'd13: hex_to_seg = SEG_D;
            4'd14: hex_to_seg = SEG_E;
            4'd15: hex_to_seg = SEG_F;
            default: hex_to_seg = SEG_OFF;
        endcase
    end
endfunction

// ​计时​1ms​进行​动态​扫描​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    end else if ( clk_cnt < CNT_MAX - 16'd1) begin
        clk_cnt <= clk_cnt + 16'd1;
    end else begin
        clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    end
end

integer i;

// ​段码​并行​生成​逻辑​ 
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if(rst) begin
        for(i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
            seg_reg[i] <= SEG_OFF;
        end
    end else begin
        seg_reg[0] <= (blank_en[0]) ? SEG_OFF : 
        (piont_en[0] ? hex_to_seg(disp_num[3:0]) & SEG_PIN : 
        hex_to_seg(disp_num[3:0]));
        seg_reg[1] <= (blank_en[1]) ? SEG_OFF : 
        (piont_en[1] ? hex_to_seg(disp_num[7:4]) & SEG_PIN : 
        hex_to_seg(disp_num[7:4]));
        seg_reg[2] <= (blank_en[2]) ? SEG_OFF :
        (piont_en[2] ? hex_to_seg(disp_num[11:8]) & SEG_PIN : 
        hex_to_seg(disp_num[11:8]));
        seg_reg[3] <= (blank_en[3]) ? SEG_OFF :
        (piont_en[3] ? hex_to_seg(disp_num[15:12]) & SEG_PIN : 
        hex_to_seg(disp_num[15:12]));
        seg_reg[4] <= (blank_en[4]) ? SEG_OFF :
        (piont_en[4] ? hex_to_seg(disp_num[19:16]) & SEG_PIN : 
        hex_to_seg(disp_num[19:16]));
        seg_reg[5] <= (blank_en[5]) ? SEG_OFF :
        (piont_en[5] ? hex_to_seg(disp_num[23:20]) & SEG_PIN : 
        hex_to_seg(disp_num[23:20]));
        seg_reg[6] <= (blank_en[6]) ? SEG_OFF :
        (piont_en[6] ? hex_to_seg(disp_num[27:24]) & SEG_PIN : 
        hex_to_seg(disp_num[27:24]));
        seg_reg[7] <= (blank_en[7]) ? SEG_OFF :
        (piont_en[7] ? hex_to_seg(disp_num[31:28]) & SEG_PIN : 
        hex_to_seg(disp_num[31:28]));
    end
end

// ​段选​逻辑​区域​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        com_io <= 8'b1111_1110;
        seg_io <= SEG_OFF;
    end else if ( clk_cnt == CNT_MAX - 16'd1) begin
        com_io <= {com_io[6:0],com_io[7]};        
    end else begin
        case (com_io)
            8'b1111_1110: seg_io <= seg_reg [7];
            8'b1111_1101: seg_io <= seg_reg [6];
            8'b1111_1011: seg_io <= seg_reg [5];
            8'b1111_0111: seg_io <= seg_reg [4];
            8'b1110_1111: seg_io <= seg_reg [3];
            8'b1101_1111: seg_io <= seg_reg [2];
            8'b1011_1111: seg_io <= seg_reg [1];
            8'b0111_1111: seg_io <= seg_reg [0];
            default: seg_io <= SEG_OFF;
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

docs.title: top_test
docs.text:
​这是​顶层​模块​，​里面​很多​内容​本​可以​再​拆成​模块​，​但​笔者​犯懒​，​就​没有​再​新建​模块​了​。

module top_test(
    input  wire       sys_clk,
    input  wire       rst_n,
    input  wire [3:0] key,
    output wire [7:0] led,
    output wire [7:0] com,
    output wire [7:0] seg,
    output wire uart_tx
    );

/* ​定义​ */

localparam NUM_MAX = 255;

reg [31:0] disp_num_reg;       // ​显示​数值​寄存器​
reg [7:0] blank_en_reg;        // ​灭​零​控制​寄存器​
reg [23:0] Number;             // 24​位​计数器​（​最大​16,777,215），​使用​BCD​码​可​显示​0-99,999,999
reg Number_Warnings;           // ​这个​信号​的​上升​沿​作为​指示灯​的​标志​信号​
reg Number_Warnings_reg;       // ​用于​取沿​
reg led_start;                 // ​警告​信号​的​上升​沿​
reg [7:0] tx_data;             // ​串口​发送​内容​
reg tx_en;                     // ​串口​使能​信号​

wire tx_busy;                   // ​串口​忙​信号​
wire [3:0] key_num;            // ​按键​信号​
// ​按下​的​是​高电平​否则​为​低电平​，​只有​一个​脉冲​

/*                 BCD​转换​函数​                  */
// ​宏​定义​
`define BCD_CHECK(bcd_high) \
    if(bcd_high >= 4'd5) bcd_high = bcd_high + 4'd3
// ​可以​用取​余​代替​，​但是​我​觉得​取余太​浪费资源​了​
// ​此处​采用​Double Dabble​算法​
function [31:0] bin_to_bcd;
    input [31:0] bin_num;    // 32​位​二进制​数​
    reg [31:0] bcd;         // 32​位​BCD​码​（8​个​数字​）
    reg [31:0] temp;        // ​临时​存储​二进制​数​
    integer i;
    begin
        bcd = 32'd0;
        temp = bin_num;     // ​复制​二进制​数​
        // ​处理​32​位​二进制​数​，​每次​处理​1​位​
        for(i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
            // ​使用​宏​定义​检查​并​调整​BCD​位​
            `BCD_CHECK(bcd[3:0]);
            `BCD_CHECK(bcd[7:4]);
            `BCD_CHECK(bcd[11:8]);
            `BCD_CHECK(bcd[15:12]);
            `BCD_CHECK(bcd[19:16]);
            `BCD_CHECK(bcd[23:20]);
            `BCD_CHECK(bcd[27:24]);
            `BCD_CHECK(bcd[31:28]);
            // ​整体​左移​一位​
            bcd = {bcd[30:0], temp[31]};
            temp = temp << 1;
        end
        bin_to_bcd = bcd;
    end
endfunction

/*                 ​灭​零​控制​函数​                  */
function [7:0] generate_blank_en;
    input [31:0] bcd_num;   // ​输入​的​8​个​BCD​数字​，​每​4​位​一个​数字​
    reg [7:0] blank_reg;    // 8​位灭​零​控制​信号​，1​表示​熄灭​
    reg [8:0] all_zero;     // all_zero[7:0]​对应​8​个​数码管​状态​
    integer i;
    begin
        // ​初始化​
        blank_reg = 8'b0000_0000;
        all_zero = 9'b1_1111_1111;
        // all_zero[8]=1​表示​虚拟​的​第​9​位为​0,​这样​写​才能​开始​下面​的​循环​

        // ​从​最高​位到​最低​位​检查​
        for(i = 7; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
            // all_zero[i+1]==1 ​表示​当前​位​左边​的​所有​位​都​是​0
            // bcd_num[i*4+:4]==4'd0 ​表示​当前​位是​0
            if(all_zero[i+1] && (bcd_num[i*4+:4] == 4'd0)) begin
                blank_reg[i] = 1'b1;  // ​灭​零​
                all_zero[i] = 1'b1;   // ​标记​为​0
            end else begin
                blank_reg[i] = 1'b0;  // ​不灭​零​
                all_zero[i] = 1'b0;   // ​标记​当前​位为​非​0，​后面​的​位​都​不​熄灭​
            end
        end

        // ​最低​位​永远​不灭​零​
        blank_reg[0] = 1'b0;

        generate_blank_en = blank_reg;
    end
endfunction

/*                 ​数码管​显示​逻辑​                  */ 
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if(rst_n) begin
        disp_num_reg <= 32'd0;
        blank_en_reg <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
        // ​将​Number​值​转换​为​BCD​码​
        disp_num_reg <= bin_to_bcd(Number);
        // ​生成​灭​零​控制​信号​
        blank_en_reg <= generate_blank_en(disp_num_reg);
    end
end

/*                Number​增减​逻辑​                */
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin               
    if (rst_n) begin                                            
        Number  <= 24'd0;                                        
        Number_Warnings <= 1'd0;                                                                    
    end else begin                                       
        case (key_num)                                                                                    
            4'b0001: begin
                    if(Number < NUM_MAX )begin
                        Number <= Number + 24'd1;
                        Number_Warnings <= 1'd0;
                    end else begin
                        Number_Warnings <= 1'd1;
                    end
            end
            4'b0010: begin                                
                    if(Number < NUM_MAX - 10)begin 
                        Number <= Number + 24'd10; 
                        Number_Warnings <= 1'd0;     
                    end else begin                
                        Number_Warnings <= 1'd1;     
                    end                                                      
            end
            4'b0100: begin
                    if(Number > 0)begin 
                        Number <= Number - 24'd1; 
                        Number_Warnings <= 1'd0;     
                    end else begin                
                        Number_Warnings <= 1'd1;     
                    end                                                         
            end 
            4'b1000: begin
                    if(Number > 9)begin 
                         Number <= Number - 24'd10; 
                        Number_Warnings <= 1'd0;     
                    end else begin                
                        Number_Warnings <= 1'd1;     
                    end
            end
            4'b1100: begin 
            // ​当​S4​和​S3​一起​按下​时​,​此时​暂时​未​解决​按键​问题​，​只能​同时​按下​  
            // ​如果​一个​按键​按下​未​抬起​再​按​下​按键​视为​最后​按下​按键​的​键值​                         
                    Number <=24'd0;
                    Number_Warnings <= 1'd0;
            end
            4'b0000: begin
                Number_Warnings <= 1'd0; 
            end
            // ​空闲​的​时候​就要​拉高​否则​如果​一直​错误​就​会​产生​BUG
            default: Number_Warnings <= 1'd1;         
        endcase                                                 

    end                                                         
end                                                             


/* ​捕获​上升​沿​，​闪灯​信号​获取​逻辑​区域​ */
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if (rst_n)
        Number_Warnings_reg <= 1'd0;
    else begin
        Number_Warnings_reg <= Number_Warnings;
        led_start <= Number_Warnings & ~Number_Warnings_reg;
    end
end

// ​当​wings​为​真的​时候​要​发送​，​因为​此时​按键​按​了​
// ​当​数字​增加​的​时候​也​要​发送​
// ​串口​状态机​定义​
localparam IDLE  = 4'd0;
localparam SEND_DIGIT_7 = 4'd1;
localparam SEND_DIGIT_6 = 4'd2;
localparam SEND_DIGIT_5 = 4'd3;
localparam SEND_DIGIT_4 = 4'd4;
localparam SEND_DIGIT_3 = 4'd5;
localparam SEND_DIGIT_2 = 4'd6;
localparam SEND_DIGIT_1 = 4'd7;
localparam SEND_CR = 4'd8;

reg [3:0] st_ur;
reg [3:0] st_next;
reg [3:0] send_cnt;  // ​发送​计数器​，​记录​发送​了​几个​数字​
reg start_send;      // ​开始​发送​标志​

/* ​串口​控制​区域​ */
// ​三段​状态机​
// ​状态机​第一段​传递​寄存器​的​状态​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if(rst_n) begin
        st_ur <= IDLE;
    end else begin
        st_ur <= st_next;
    end
end

// ​状态机​第二段​ - ​组合​逻辑​
always @ (*) begin
    // ​默认​状态​保持​
    st_next = st_ur;

    case (st_ur)
        IDLE: begin
            if(start_send) begin
                st_next = SEND_DIGIT_7;
            end
        end
        SEND_DIGIT_7: begin
            if(!tx_busy && send_cnt >= 1 ) begin
                st_next = SEND_DIGIT_6;
            end
        end
        SEND_DIGIT_6: begin
            if(!tx_busy && send_cnt >= 2 ) begin
                st_next = SEND_DIGIT_5;
            end
        end
        SEND_DIGIT_5: begin
            if(!tx_busy && send_cnt >= 3 ) begin
                st_next = SEND_DIGIT_4;
            end
        end
        SEND_DIGIT_4: begin
            if(!tx_busy && send_cnt >= 4 ) begin
                st_next = SEND_DIGIT_3;
            end
        end
        SEND_DIGIT_3: begin
            if(!tx_busy && send_cnt >= 5 ) begin
                st_next = SEND_DIGIT_2;
            end
        end
        SEND_DIGIT_2: begin
            if(!tx_busy && send_cnt >= 6 ) begin
                st_next = SEND_DIGIT_1;
            end
        end
        SEND_DIGIT_1: begin
            if(!tx_busy && send_cnt >= 7 ) begin
                st_next = SEND_CR;
            end
        end
        SEND_CR: begin
            if(!tx_busy && send_cnt >= 8 ) begin
                st_next = IDLE;
            end
        end
        default: st_next = IDLE;
    endcase
end

// ​生成​开始​发送​信号​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if(rst_n) begin
        start_send <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        // ​当有​按键​按下​或​LED​开始​闪烁​时​，​触发​发送​
        if((key_num != 0) || led_start) begin
            start_send <= 1'b1;
        end else if(st_ur != IDLE) begin
            start_send <= 1'b0;
        end
    end
end

// ​状态机​第三段​ - ​时序​逻辑​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if(rst_n) begin
        tx_en <= 1'b0;
        tx_data <= 8'b0;
        send_cnt <= 0;
    end else begin
        tx_en <= 1'b0;  // ​默认​不使​能​

        case (st_ur)
            IDLE: begin
                send_cnt <= 0;
                if(start_send) begin
                    // ​准备​发送​第一个​数字​
                    tx_data <= disp_num_reg[31:28] + "0";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                end
            end

            SEND_DIGIT_7: begin
                if(!tx_busy && send_cnt == 0) begin
                    tx_data <= disp_num_reg[27:24] + "0";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                    send_cnt <= 1;
                end
            end

            SEND_DIGIT_6: begin
                if(!tx_busy && send_cnt == 1) begin
                    tx_data <= disp_num_reg[23:20] + "0";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                    send_cnt <= 2;
                end
            end

            SEND_DIGIT_5: begin
                if(!tx_busy && send_cnt == 2) begin
                    tx_data <= disp_num_reg[19:16]  + "0";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                    send_cnt <= 3;
                end
            end

            SEND_DIGIT_4: begin
                if(!tx_busy && send_cnt == 3) begin
                    tx_data <= disp_num_reg[15:12]  + "0";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                    send_cnt <= 4;
                end
            end

            SEND_DIGIT_3: begin
                if(!tx_busy && send_cnt == 4) begin
                    tx_data <= disp_num_reg[11:8]  + "0";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                    send_cnt <= 5;
                end
            end

            SEND_DIGIT_2: begin
                if(!tx_busy && send_cnt == 5) begin
                    tx_data <= disp_num_reg[7:4]  + "0";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                    send_cnt <= 6;
                end
            end

            SEND_DIGIT_1: begin
                if(!tx_busy && send_cnt == 6) begin
                    tx_data <= disp_num_reg[3:0]  + "0";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                    send_cnt <= 7;
                end
            end

            SEND_CR: begin
                if(!tx_busy && send_cnt == 7) begin
                    tx_data <= "\n";
                    tx_en <= 1'b1;
                    send_cnt <= 8;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

/* ​模块​例化​ */
seg u_seg(
    .clk         (sys_clk),
    .rst         (rst_n),
    .disp_num    (disp_num_reg),
    .blank_en    (blank_en_reg),
    .com_io      (com),
    .seg_io      (seg)
);


key u_key(
    .clk          (sys_clk),
    .rst          (rst_n),
    .key_in       (key),
    .key_val      (key_num)
);

led_flicker u_led_flicker (
    .clk          (sys_clk),
    .rst          (rst_n),
    .led_start    (led_start),
    .led_out      (led)
);

uart_tx u_uart_tx (
    .clk          (sys_clk),
    .rst          (rst_n),
    .tx_data      (tx_data),
    .tx_en        (tx_en),
    .tx_busy      (tx_busy),
    .tx           (uart_tx)          
);

endmodule

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​一些​想​说​的​ ​这​段​代码​还​不是​很​完美​，​比如​串口​输出​时会​夹杂​高位​0，​这​可以​利用​灭​零​逻辑​里​的​寄存器​、​通过​位​的​数值​来​判断​；​另外​，​按下​两个​按键​的​写法​还有​待​优化​。

docs.title: 按键​+​数码管​+AT24C02
docs.text:
​目标​ ​针对​0-9​的​数值​，​实现​如下​功能​： S1​向​地址​0​写入​数据​，S2​从​该​地址​读出​数据​，S3​减​，S4​加​，​读数据​的​同时​数码管​要​显示​读出​的​数据​ ​数码管​的​显示​格式​为​： ​加减​的​数值​ ​灭​ ​灭​ ​灭​ ​灭​ ​灭​ ​灭​ ​读出​的​数值​ ​本​实验​来自​4T​科技​的​教学​视频​

​以下​是​top​代码​，​底层​代码​不再​赘述​：

module AT24C02_top(
    input wire sys_clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire [3:0] key_in,
    output wire [7:0] com,
    output wire [7:0] seg,
    output wire iic_scl,
    inout  wire iic_sda
    );

localparam ADDR_BYTE_NUM = 1; // ​地址​的​字节数​
localparam DATA_BYTE_NUM = 1; // ​数据​的​字节数​

/*                              ​模块​部分​                              */

// iic ​信号​      

reg iic_start;       //​读写操作​开始​信号​     0:     1:​开始​                  
wire iic_ready;      //​设备​忙​、​闲​指示​信号​   0:​繁忙​  1:​空闲​                     
reg iic_rw_flag;     //​读写​标志​信号​         0:​写​    1：​读​                 

//reg [ADDR_BYTE_NUM*8 -1 :0] iic_word_addr;        //​读写​的​数据​地址​                                   
//reg [DATA_BYTE_NUM*8 -1 :0] iic_wdata;            //​写​的​数据​ (​先写​高字节​数据​的​高位​)                         

wire [DATA_BYTE_NUM*8 -1 :0] iic_rdata;            //​读​的​数据​ (​先读​高字节​数据​的​高位​)                         
wire iic_rdata_valid;      //​读数据​有效​信号​       0:​无效​    1:​有效​                

wire iic_ack_error;        //​应答​失败​信号​         0:​应答​正常​ 1:​应答​失败​              


// ​按键​信号​

wire [3:0] key_val;

/*                              ​功能​实现​部分​                              */
reg [7:0] cnt_key;
reg [7:0] Number;

// ​按键​功能​部分​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if(rst_n) begin
        cnt_key <= 8'd0;
        iic_rw_flag <= 1'd0;
    end else begin
        case (key_val)
            4'b0001: begin
            if(iic_ready) iic_rw_flag <= 1'd0;
            end // ​写​功能​
            4'b0010: begin
            if(iic_ready) iic_rw_flag <= 1'd1;
            end
            4'b0100: begin
            if(cnt_key > 0) cnt_key <= cnt_key - 1'd1;
            else cnt_key <= 8'd9;
            end
            4'b1000: begin 
            if(cnt_key < 9) cnt_key <= cnt_key + 1'd1;
            else cnt_key <= 8'd0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

// iic​启动​控制​位​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if (rst_n)
        iic_start <= 1'd0;
    else if (iic_ready && (key_val == 4'b0001 || key_val == 4'b0010))
            iic_start <= 1'd1;
    else iic_start <= 1'd0;
end

// ​读取​EEPROM
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge rst_n) begin
    if (rst_n)
        Number <= 8'd0;
    else if (iic_rdata_valid)
            Number <= iic_rdata;
end

key u_key(
     .clk          (sys_clk),
     .rst          (rst_n  ),
     .key_in       (key_in ),
     .key_neg      (key_val)
);

seg u_seg(
    .clk           (sys_clk),
    .rst           (rst_n  ),
    .disp_num      ({cnt_key [3:0],24'd0,Number [3:0]}), 
    .blank_en      (8'b0111_1110),
    .com_io        (com),
    .seg_io        (seg)
);

iic_drive # (
    .P_SYS_CLK               (28'd50_000_000),
    .P_IIC_SCL               (28'd125_000),
    .P_DEVICE_ADDR           (7 'b1010_000),
    .P_ADDR_BYTE_NUM         (ADDR_BYTE_NUM),
    .P_DATA_BYTE_NUM         (DATA_BYTE_NUM)
) u_iic_drive (
     .iic_clk                (sys_clk        ),
     .iic_rst                (rst_n        ), 
     // ​传输​开始​信号​  
     .iic_start              (iic_start      ),
     .iic_ready              (iic_ready      ),
     .iic_rw_flag            (iic_rw_flag    ),  
     // ​写​数据​ 
     .iic_word_addr          ('d0  ),
     .iic_wdata              (cnt_key      ),
     // ​读数据​ 
     .iic_rdata              (iic_rdata      ),
     .iic_rdata_valid        (iic_rdata_valid),
     // ​传输​失败​标志​位​
     .iic_ack_error          (iic_ack_error  ),
     // IIC​物理​IO​口​
     .iic_scl                (iic_scl        ),
     .iic_sda                (iic_sda        )
);

endmodule

docs.title: 第九​部分​　​综合​实例​（​二​）：16 ​届​模拟​一
docs.text:
​此题​比较简单​，​很​适合​用来​做​第一次​测试​、​增加​信心​

docs.text:

    );

wire [7:0]  bcd_out_num2;

docs.title: 数码管​显示​部分
docs.text:
module seg(
    input wire        clk,
    input wire        rst,
    input wire [31:0] disp_num,// 32​位​显示​数字​，​每​4​位​代表​一个​十六进制​数​
    // 
    input wire [7:0]  blank_en, // ​灭​零​控制​信号​，​对应​8​个​数码管​，1​表示​灭​零​
    input wire [7:0]  piont_en, // ​小数点​控制​信号​，​对应​8​个​数码管​，1​表示​小数点​
    output reg [7:0]  com_io,   // ​数码管​位选​引脚​
    output reg [7:0]  seg_io    // ​数码管​段选​引脚​
    );
// 1ms
parameter CNT_MAX = 16'd50_000;// 50MHz / 1000Hz = 50000

localparam SEG_OFF = 8'hff,
           SEG_0   = 8'hC0,
           SEG_1   = 8'hF9,
           SEG_2   = 8'hA4,
           SEG_3   = 8'hB0,
           SEG_4   = 8'h99,
           SEG_5   = 8'h92,
           SEG_6   = 8'h82,
           SEG_7   = 8'hF8,
           SEG_8   = 8'h80,
           SEG_9   = 8'h90,
           SEG_A   = 8'h88,
           SEG_B   = 8'h83,
           SEG_C   = 8'hC6,
           SEG_D   = 8'hA1,
           SEG_E   = 8'h86,
           SEG_F   = 8'h8E,
           SEG_DP  = 8'h6F,
           SEG__   = ~8'h40;

reg [15:0] clk_cnt;      // 1ms​计时​计数器​
reg [7:0] seg_reg [0:7]; // 8​个​数码管​的​段码​数据​

// ​计时​1ms​进行​动态​扫描​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    end else if ( clk_cnt < CNT_MAX - 16'd1) begin
        clk_cnt <= clk_cnt + 16'd1;
    end else begin
        clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
    end
end

// ​段码​转换​函数​,​用于​通过​数值​来​找​段​码表​
function [7:0] hex_to_seg;
    input [3:0] hex_data;
    begin
        case (hex_data)
            4'd0: hex_to_seg = SEG_0;
            4'd1: hex_to_seg = SEG_1;
            4'd2: hex_to_seg = SEG_2;
            4'd3: hex_to_seg = SEG_3;
            4'd4: hex_to_seg = SEG_4;
            4'd5: hex_to_seg = SEG_5;
            4'd6: hex_to_seg = SEG_6;
            4'd7: hex_to_seg = SEG_7;
            4'd8: hex_to_seg = SEG_8;
            4'd9: hex_to_seg = SEG_9;
            4'd10: hex_to_seg = SEG_A;
            4'd11: hex_to_seg = SEG_B;
            4'd12: hex_to_seg = SEG_C;
            4'd13: hex_to_seg = SEG_D;
            4'd14: hex_to_seg = SEG_E;
            4'd15: hex_to_seg = SEG_F;
            default: hex_to_seg = SEG_OFF;
        endcase
    end
endfunction

//seg_reg ​赋值​部分​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst)
    if( rst ) begin
        seg_reg[0] <= SEG_OFF;
        seg_reg[1] <= SEG_OFF;
        seg_reg[2] <= SEG__;
        seg_reg[3] <= SEG_OFF;
        seg_reg[4] <= SEG_OFF;
        seg_reg[5] <= SEG_OFF;
        seg_reg[6] <= SEG_OFF;
        seg_reg[7] <= SEG_OFF;
   end else begin
        seg_reg[0] <= blank_en[0] ? SEG_OFF : ((piont_en[0]) ? (hex_to_seg(disp_num[3 : 0]) & SEG_DP) : hex_to_seg(disp_num[3 : 0]));
        seg_reg[1] <= blank_en[1] ? SEG_OFF : ((piont_en[1]) ? (hex_to_seg(disp_num[7 : 4]) & SEG_DP) : hex_to_seg(disp_num[7 : 4]));
        seg_reg[3] <= blank_en[3] ? SEG_OFF : ((piont_en[3]) ? (hex_to_seg(disp_num[15:12]) & SEG_DP) : hex_to_seg(disp_num[15:12]));
        seg_reg[4] <= blank_en[4] ? SEG_OFF : ((piont_en[4]) ? (hex_to_seg(disp_num[19:16]) & SEG_DP) : hex_to_seg(disp_num[19:16]));
        seg_reg[6] <= blank_en[6] ? SEG_OFF : ((piont_en[6]) ? (hex_to_seg(disp_num[27:24]) & SEG_DP) : hex_to_seg(disp_num[27:24]));
        seg_reg[7] <= blank_en[7] ? SEG_OFF : ((piont_en[7]) ? (hex_to_seg(disp_num[31:28]) & SEG_DP) : hex_to_seg(disp_num[31:28]));
   end


// ​段选​逻辑​区域​
always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if( rst ) begin
        com_io <= 8'b1111_1110;
        seg_io <= SEG_OFF;
    end else if ( clk_cnt == CNT_MAX - 16'd1) begin
        com_io <= {com_io[6:0],com_io[7]};        
    end else begin
        case (com_io)
            8'b1111_1110: seg_io <= seg_reg [7];
            8'b1111_1101: seg_io <= seg_reg [6];
            8'b1111_1011: seg_io <= seg_reg [5];
            8'b1111_0111: seg_io <= seg_reg [4];
            8'b1110_1111: seg_io <= seg_reg [3];
            8'b1101_1111: seg_io <= seg_reg [2];
            8'b1011_1111: seg_io <= seg_reg [1];
            8'b0111_1111: seg_io <= seg_reg [0];
            default: seg_io <= SEG_OFF;
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

// 0-99 ​转码​
module bcd(
    input  wire           sys_clk,
    input  wire           sys_rst,
    input  wire   [7:0]   data_in,
    output reg    [7:0]   bcd_out
    );

// ​位​宽​介绍​
localparam  DATA_WIDTH  = 8;                         // ​输入​数据位​宽​
localparam  BCD_DIGITS  = 2;                         // BCD​码​位数​（​十位​和​个位​）
localparam  SHIFT_WIDTH = BCD_DIGITS*4 + DATA_WIDTH; // ​移位​寄存器​总位​宽​ = 8+8=16
localparam  CNT_MAX     = DATA_WIDTH + 1;            // ​计数器​最大值​ = 9

// reg ​定义​
reg [4:0]               cnt_shift   ;   // ​移位​计数器​，0~9（​使用​5​位​防止​溢出​）
reg [15:0]              data_shift  ;   // ​移位​数据​寄存器​，[15:12]​十位​，[11:8]​个​位​，[7:0]​原始数据​   SHIFT_WIDTH - 1 ​位​宽​
reg                     shift_flag  ;   // ​移位​/​加​3​标志​：0-​加​3​判断​，1-​左移​

// cnt_shift：​移位​次数​计数器​
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        cnt_shift <= 5'd0;
    else if ((cnt_shift == CNT_MAX) && shift_flag)  // ​达到​最大值​时​清零​
        cnt_shift <= 5'd0;
    else if (shift_flag)                             // shift_flag=1​时​计数​加​1
        cnt_shift <= cnt_shift + 1'b1;
    else
        cnt_shift <= cnt_shift;
end

//data_shift：​计数器​为​0​时赋​初值​，​计数器​为​1~9​时​进行​移位​判断​操作​
always@(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst)
    if(sys_rst)
        data_shift  <=  16'b0;
    else    if(!cnt_shift)
        data_shift  <=  {8'b0,data_in};
    else    if((cnt_shift <= DATA_WIDTH) && (shift_flag == 1'b0))
        begin
            data_shift[11: 8]   <=  (data_shift[11: 8] > 4) ? (data_shift[11: 8] + 2'd3) : (data_shift[11: 8]);
            data_shift[15:12]   <=  (data_shift[15:12] > 4) ? (data_shift[15:12] + 2'd3) : (data_shift[15:12]);
        end
    else    if((cnt_shift <= DATA_WIDTH) && (shift_flag == 1'b1))
        data_shift  <=  data_shift << 1;
    else
        data_shift  <=  data_shift;

//shift_flag：​移位​判断​标志​信号​，​用于​控制​移位​判断​的​先后顺序​
always@(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst)
    if(sys_rst)
        shift_flag  <=  1'b0;
    else
        shift_flag  <=  ~shift_flag;

//​当​计数器​等于​9​时​，​移位​判断​操作​完成​，​对​各​个位数​的​BCD​码​进行​赋值​
always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        bcd_out <= 8'd0;
    else if (cnt_shift == CNT_MAX) 
        bcd_out <= data_shift[15:8];
end

endmodule

module key_neg(
        input  wire           sys_clk,
        input  wire           sys_rst,
        input  wire  [3:0]    key_in ,
        output wire  [3:0]    key_neg
    );

localparam CLK_FREQ    = 50_000_000;// hz
localparam TIM_DELAT   = 10; // ms
localparam MAX_SYS_CNT = CLK_FREQ / 1000 * TIM_DELAT;// sys_cnt

reg [3:0] key_in_reg0;
reg [3:0] key_in_reg1;
reg [3:0] key_reg0;
reg [3:0] key_reg1;
reg [18:0] sys_cnt;

// ​消除​亚稳态​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst) begin
        key_in_reg0 <= 4'hf;
        key_in_reg1 <= 4'hf;
    end else begin
        key_in_reg0 <= key_in;
        key_in_reg1 <= key_in_reg0; 
    end
end

// ​计数​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst) begin
        sys_cnt <= 19'd0;
    end else if ( sys_cnt == MAX_SYS_CNT - 1'd1 ) begin
        sys_cnt <= 19'd0;
    end else begin
        sys_cnt <= sys_cnt + 1'd1;
    end
end

// ​采样​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst) begin
        key_reg0 <= 4'b1111;
        key_reg1 <= 4'b1111;
    end else if ( sys_cnt == MAX_SYS_CNT - 1'd1 ) begin
        key_reg0 <= key_in_reg1;
        key_reg1 <= key_reg0   ;
    end else begin
        key_reg0 <= key_reg0   ;
        key_reg1 <= key_reg1   ;
    end
end

assign key_neg = (sys_cnt == MAX_SYS_CNT - 1'd1) ? ~key_reg0 & key_reg1 :4'b0000;

endmodule

module time_20s(
    input  wire           sys_clk  ,
    input  wire           sys_rst  ,
    input  wire           flag_st  ,
    output wire    [4:0]  clk      ,
    output reg            stop_flag,  //​停止​时候​会​被​拉高​，​保持​高电平​
    output reg            con_flag    //​暂停​时候​高电平​，​启动​拉低​
    );

// 20ns -> 20ms->1s -> 20s

localparam IDLE = 3'b001,
           KEEP = 3'b010,
           STOP = 3'b100;

parameter CNT_MAX = 20'd1000_000;
parameter CNT_MAX_1s = 9'd50;
reg  [19:0] cnt_20ms;
reg  [8:0] cnt_1s; 
reg  [4:0] cnt_20s;
reg  [3:0] state;

// ​状态机​部分​，​这里​第一次​写​比较​混乱​，​采用​新​二段式​状态机​
// ​这​里面​的​flag​信号​都​改成​state​的​状态​标​表示​会​好​一点​，​我​这样​写​有点​混乱​
always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        state <= STOP;// ​题目​要求​开始​上电是​停止​状态​
    else
        case (state)
            IDLE : state <= (con_flag) ? KEEP : ((stop_flag) ? STOP : IDLE);
            KEEP : state <= (con_flag) ? KEEP : IDLE;
            STOP : state <= (flag_st) ?  IDLE : STOP;
        default : state <= IDLE;
        endcase
end

always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        con_flag <= 1'd0;
    else
        case (state)
            IDLE : if (flag_st) con_flag <= 1'b1;
            KEEP : if (flag_st) con_flag <= 1'b0;
        endcase
end

always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        stop_flag <= 1'd1;
    else
        case (state)
            IDLE : if ((cnt_20ms == CNT_MAX - 1)  && (cnt_1s ==  CNT_MAX_1s - 1) && (cnt_20s ==  5'd0)) stop_flag <= 1'b1;
            STOP : if (flag_st) stop_flag <= 1'b0;
        endcase
end

always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        cnt_20ms <= 19'd0;
    else if (stop_flag)
        cnt_20ms <= 19'd0;
    else if (con_flag)
        cnt_20ms <= cnt_20ms;
    else if ((cnt_20ms == CNT_MAX - 1))
       cnt_20ms <= 19'd0;
    else
       cnt_20ms <= cnt_20ms + 1'd1;
end

always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        cnt_1s <= 9'd0;
    else if (stop_flag)
        cnt_1s <= 9'd0;
    else if (con_flag)
        cnt_1s <= cnt_1s;
    else if ((cnt_20ms == CNT_MAX - 1) && (cnt_1s ==  CNT_MAX_1s - 1))
       cnt_1s <= 9'd0;
    else  if(cnt_20ms == CNT_MAX - 1)
       cnt_1s <= cnt_1s + 1'd1;
end

always @ (posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst)
        cnt_20s <= 5'd20;
    else if (stop_flag)
        cnt_20s <= 5'd20;
    else if (con_flag)
        cnt_20s <= cnt_20s;
    else  if((cnt_20ms == CNT_MAX - 1) && (cnt_1s ==  CNT_MAX_1s - 1))
       cnt_20s <= cnt_20s - 1'd1;
end 

assign clk = cnt_20s;// ​可以​直接​输出​出来​，​这里​我​懒得​改了​

endmodule
